overview: An augmented reality platform that lets USAA members explore, identify, and get real-time vehicle information by simply pointing their phones at nearby cars.

sections.label: The Challenge
sections.headline: Car shopping was a research nightmare.

cards.text: Finding accurate vehicle specs, pricing, and comparisons required endless tab switching.
Financial details like insurance and loan quotes lived in separate apps entirely.
The gap between seeing a car and understanding if you could afford it was too wide.

features.name: Vehicle Recognition
features.headline: Point. Scan. Know.
features.description: Walk around a vehicle while the phone scans and recognizes it instantly. The app returns specs, pricing, ratings, and offers insurance/loan quotes from USAA—all in real time.

features.name: Contextual Insights
features.headline: Info when you need it.
features.description: Offer insights in a non-intrusive, intuitive way. Information appears naturally in your view—no app switching, no tab juggling.

features.name: Financial Integration
features.headline: Decide with confidence.
features.description: Empower confident financial decisions with in-context info. See what you can afford, get quotes, and understand total cost—all while standing next to the car.

items: Members want everything integrated and helpful
Users lack confidence in major financial decisions
Desire for automated, relevant, non-cluttered experiences

sections.title: Functionality Prioritization
paragraphs: Research led to a leaner MVP — showing relevant info first, with deeper layers accessible through interaction rather than overload.

sections.title: Testing
paragraphs: Tested with 12 members. Findings confirmed excitement about AR, but highlighted the need for simplified UIs and optional onboarding for first-time users.

items.title: Not all info belongs in AR
